name: Entity Usage Addons
description: Two integer field formatters that render where an entity is used (a detailed list of referencing entities, or a linked count), reusing data collected by the Entity Usage module.
project_description: Entity Usage Addons is a small add-on to the Entity Usage module. It ships two integer field formatters and one helper service that surface Entity Usage's tracking data directly on an entity or Views display: a detailed formatter that lists the entities referencing the current entity (with per-row ID, entity link, publish status, and type columns), and a count formatter that renders a linked total. Place either formatter on an ID field via Manage display or a Views field. It has no routes, no permissions of its own, and no configuration page; the display-level formatter settings are the only configuration.
